commands.command: cargo test -p quansio-qworkerd --test browser -- --test-threads=1  # 4 passed against a real headless Google Chrome this host has installed: the DOM is read first and a screenshot is taken only when the DOM names nothing (a canvas page), with the PNG asserted by its signature; a click is classified from the page's own semantics before it runs (egress tier 2, payment tier 4, deletion tier 3, a form submit tier 2, an in-page anchor and an inert toggle as no effect at all) and the page's own handler is asserted to have run; web.fetch is bounded, labelled UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL and digested with the source URL and retrieval time; and a takeover fences agent input without duplicating the session

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=... cargo test -p quansio-machine --test browser  # 4 passed against real PostgreSQL: a session and its tabs survive the worker and a takeover hands over the same row; a policy pause cannot be resumed by a handback; a closed session is terminal and keeps its checkpoint; and a session is scoped to its tenant with an undefined state refused by the schema
cargo test --workspace  # 504 passed across 82 suites, zero failures
cargo fmt --all --check and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings  # clean

python3.12 scripts/validate_v81.py && scripts/ci/dossier_consistency.py && scripts/ci/arch_check.py && scripts/ci/check_authority.py --check && scripts/ci/workspace_check.py && scripts/ci/supply_chain/check.py && scripts/ci/legacy_map_check.py && scripts/ci/inventory.py --scan  # all CLEAN, including supply-chain with tokio-tungstenite; V8.1 PASS
